verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents a first-party Store API with public REST endpoints for customer-facing product, cart, and checkout functionality. It covers searching and filtering product lists, converting carts to orders, collecting addresses, and facilitating payment, which is the core a custom headless storefront needs. Missing for 10: explicit headless or decoupled-frontend guidance (e.g. auth/session handling for a separate frontend app), a first-party headless frontend framework or storefront SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building a headless storefront.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a fully custom headless storefront on a documented storefront API or first-party frontend framework

citations.quote: The Store API provides public Rest API endpoints for the development of customer-facing cart, checkout, and product functionality.
Obtaining a list of products to display that can be searched or filtered... Converting a customer’s cart to an Order, collecting addresses, and then facilitating payment
